# MTM Armory: llms.txt
## Field Kit Micro-Utility Tools for MT Media AI

## Organization
- Name: MT Media AI (Modern Touch Media)
- Canonical URL: https://mtmediaai.com

## Summary
MTM Armory is the micro-utility application suite of MT Media AI. It hosts deterministic calculators, AI visibility diagnostics, margin simulators, and territory availability auditors engineered for The Invisible Elite (Estate-Level Service Providers).

## Tools Hosted
- AI Visibility Health Diagnostic
- Sovereign Margin & LTV Simulator
- Territory Exclusivity Auditor (Sequoia Doctrine)
- Citation Decay Tracker

## Target Audience
- The Invisible Elite (Estate-Level Service Providers)
- Ambitious SME Dynasty Builders ($1M–$15M+ annual revenue)
- Luxury Real Estate Brokers & Estate Artisans
